vectors.domain: Signed/Unsigned Promotion Traps under -Wconversion (-1 Blue & +1 Red Hot Paths)
vectors.hostile_attack: Compiled all C99 translation units and shared libraries under `gcc -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wformat=2 -Wconversion -Wundef -Werror` while feeding negative trits (`-1`) into `mod3_sum(a,b)`, bit-shifts, and `<ctype.h>` character classifiers.
vectors.shallow_bug_surfaced: C99 integer promotion rules promote `int8_t` and `uint8_t` operands in `(a + b + 4) % 3 - 1`, `crc ^= (data[i] << 8)`, and `mag_row[b] | (1U << bit)` to `int`, triggering `-Wconversion` errors or implementation-defined negative modulo behavior if `a + b` is not shifted positive before `% 3`.
vectors.c99_remediation: Enforced `static inline int8_t mod3_sum(int8_t a, int8_t b) { return (int8_t)(((a + b + 4) % 3) - 1); }` where `a + b + 4 >= 2 > 0` for all `a, b in {-1, 0, +1}`, added explicit narrowing casts on all `uint8_t` / `uint16_t` bitwise accumulators, and cast all `<ctype.h>` inputs through `(unsigned char)`.
